_status: DEPRECATED · 正面立面 v4c 旧锚点，仅沿革留档；现行卡面标准见 design/art/card-art-generation-standard-v1.md v1.8（3/4 视角图生图 + 包色整机主色）。勿用于新卡生成。
anchor: Flat vector game card illustration in engineering blueprint style, medium detail density. Exactly ONE large geometric silhouette as the subject, centered, readable at thumbnail size, divided into two or three stacked segments (base, body, cap) by one or two horizontal seams. Exactly ONE functional part, its orientation exactly as described, never a cluster of small parts. Interior structure lines: two to four panel seams, plus one or two small circular or rectangular ports; 6-8 shape blocks total. Bold thick uniform near-black navy #001830 outline, at least 6 px wide at 1024 resolution, on the outer silhouette and along every segment. Exact palette: #001830 outline, light steel grey #A0B8C8 as the dominant fill, mid steel grey #405868 for shadow panels, plus ONE accent. No neutral warm grey. The silhouette MUST be solid-filled: light steel grey covers at least 60 percent of its area, with a tall upright tower-like proportion, a clearly separated stepped base plinth and a distinct cap. Never a hollow outline, never a thin frame, never a dark body, never a C-shaped clamp, never detached floating parts, never a flat horizontal wedge. The accent color appears on ONE main block plus at most two small same-hue accents, nowhere else. Background: solid flat #141726 ONLY, absolutely no grid lines, no texture, no frame border, no other pattern. Strict frontal elevation view, symmetrical. NOT isometric, NOT 3/4 perspective, NOT top-down. No gradients, no shading, no glow, no halo, no lens flare, no painterly texture, no stippling, no hatching. No gear trains, no rivet rows, no layered armour plates, no circuitry, no ornament, no small mechanical greebles, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no characters, no scene, no environment, not a chess piece, not a lighthouse. 1024x1024, the silhouette fills 74% of frame height and about 60 percent of frame width, 8% safe margin on all sides, nothing cropped at edges.
